name: pointable-context
description: Selection-triggered, zero-turn development context reveal in the native Codex Chat Lane.

interface.shortDescription: Select a reference and reveal verified context in place.
interface.longDescription: Keep the Codex Chat Lane quiet until the user selects a stable file, module, decision, test, or configuration reference. A trusted explicit action reveals bounded, type-specific detail beside the selection without opening a browser, calling a model, or creating another chat turn. Open workspace cards pin their snapshot, signal detected file revision drift, and refresh in place only after another trusted action. Test source never implies PASS/FAIL, configuration values stay hidden, and deterministic identity matching remains available; semantic concept recognition, browser clients, and DCPM/CWA are not product dependencies.
